about.title: Building skills, earning independently, and preparing for scale.
about.description: A complete look at my background in Odisha, my daily work across technology and digital services, and the direction I am actively building toward.
about.story:
My name is Purandar Sahu, and in my local community I am widely known as Pinku. I belong to the Paikmal region of Bargarh district, Odisha. From an early stage, I chose to combine practical digital skills with real-world service work to build my future.

Today, my daily routine revolves around five interconnected areas. First, I run Pinku Digital Point, my cyber cafe and digital service center, which serves as my primary source of income and ground-level business training. Helping students, job seekers, farmers, and families with online job portals, government certificates, scholarships, and documentation has taught me customer handling, accuracy under pressure, and financial responsibility.

Second, I work as a Frontend Developer—designing and deploying clean, responsive websites using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub Pages, and Cloudflare. Alongside web development, I am actively learning Cyber Security fundamentals—understanding how web applications, networks, authentication systems, and online data stay protected against common vulnerabilities.

On the academic front, after scoring 77.17% (463/600) in my Class 10 board exams, I faced a setback in +2 where I could not clear three subjects in the board exams. Rather than letting that pause my progress, I took fresh admission in NIOS Senior Secondary (Class 12) so I can complete my formal education while continuing to grow my technical skills and business operations toward my long-term goal of launching a registered Private Limited (Pvt. Ltd.) company.

business.title: Pinku Digital Point
business.description: My independent digital service center in Paikmal, Odisha — turning everyday online and government portal processes into fast, transparent, and reliable support for local citizens and students.
business.story:
Pinku Digital Point is more than just a name—it is my self-built earning platform where I handle real cyber cafe and digital service operations every day. For many students, job seekers, farmers, and families in rural and semi-urban areas, navigating complex online portals, document upload specifications, payment gateways, and official forms can be stressful and prone to costly errors.

At Pinku Digital Point, every application is checked carefully before submission. Whether someone needs to apply for a competitive recruitment exam, update their PAN card, download an e-District certificate, register a small business under Udyam or FSSAI, or get urgent printouts and scanned PDFs prepared to exact KB dimensions, I aim to ensure clear communication, upfront service charges, and reliable follow-up.

educationTimeline.school: National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) — Stream 1, Block 1
educationTimeline.description: After facing an academic setback in my regular +2 board exams, I took a practical decision to restart cleanly by enrolling in NIOS Senior Secondary through fresh admission based on my Class 10 qualification. This flexible open-schooling structure allows me to study systematically, prepare subject by subject, and complete my Class 12 qualification while simultaneously running Pinku Digital Point and building my web development skills.

educationTimeline.school: Vindhya Vasini Higher Secondary School, Paikmal
educationTimeline.description: Completed two years pursuing Higher Secondary (+2) education in the Arts/Humanities stream. Scored 265 out of 600 and did not pass three subjects. I treated this as a turning point, took responsibility for my study routine, and enrolled in NIOS to complete Class 12 with a more structured plan while continuing to build my skills and work.

Completed two years of secondary schooling (Classes 9 and 10) and appeared for the BSE Odisha Class 10 Board Examination in 2024. Passed with 463 out of 600 marks (77.17%), building a strong academic base and sharpening my interest in computers, internet tools, and digital systems.
Completed eight foundational years of schooling from Class 1 through Class 8.

vision.title: Building toward a Private Limited (Pvt. Ltd.) Company
vision.description: Turning grassroots digital service experience and technical skills into an organized, scalable enterprise.
vision.heading: From a Local Digital Center to an Organized Corporate Venture
vision.story:
My long-term vision is to build and register my own Private Limited (Pvt. Ltd.) Company. Working at the ground level through Pinku Digital Point has shown me firsthand how much demand exists in semi-urban and rural India for trustworthy digital infrastructure, web development, e-governance facilitation, and organized local services.

Instead of staying limited to solo freelance work or a single counter, I am systematically learning business operations, customer acquisition, web technologies, and digital security today so that once I complete my Senior Secondary education and cross key legal and financial milestones, I can scale into a structured company that delivers high-value digital and local services while creating employment opportunities for other young people in my region.
